subject: SIG evidence delivery & runbook/screenshots for FinTrust
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@fintrust.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@fintrust.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up + outstanding evidence items

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for working on the SIG. Our security team completed the initial pass and flagged a few outstanding evidence items we still need to close the questionnaire:

- Administrative policies: signed InfoSec policy and data retention schedule (PDF).
- Network diagram: high-level VPC/network diagram showing ingress controls and peering (screenshot/PDF).
- Incident runbook: the incident response runbook (PDF) and a short video/annotated screenshot showing the escalation steps.
- Audit logs: a timestamped screenshot from your audit logging console showing an example retention entry and search.

Could you share a single Drive folder or links to the specific artifacts? We prefer links that allow view-only access. If any of these require special handling, please call out redaction or NDAs.

We’re working to turn this around quickly — ideally by end of week.

Best,
Asha
Security Engineer | FinTrust Capital
asha.reddy@fintrust.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@fintrust.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up + outstanding evidence items

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list.

We can provide everything you requested. I’m looping in Dev (infra) and Vivek (security/compliance) to assemble the artifacts and provide view-only Drive links.

Quick notes:
- The signed InfoSec policy and retention schedule are in our compliance repo; we’ll export to PDF and place in the Drive folder.
- Network diagram: we’ll export the latest VPC diagram (redacted for internal IPs) and include an explanatory thumbnail.
- Runbook: we’ll include the PDF runbook and a short annotated screenshot showing the escalation path.
- Audit log screenshot: we will provide a timestamped, redacted screenshot and include the query used.

I’ll send a consolidated folder link shortly. If FinTrust needs artifacts delivered via an alternate secure channel (SFTP or a signed expiring URL), flag it.

Hannah
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SIG follow-up + outstanding evidence items — action items

Team — forwarding Asha’s ask. Can you please pull the artifacts below and drop into a single shared Drive folder (see naming guidance in thread). Owner assignments:

- Dev: export signed InfoSec policy (latest signed copy), data retention schedule, and SOC2 evidence manifest PDF.
- Vivek: network diagram export (redact internal-only IP ranges), audit log screenshot (include exact query + timestamp), and annotated runbook screenshot.
- Marissa: (cc’d separately) please review for PII and confirm redaction before we share externally.

Target timeline: get links to me by EOD tomorrow (Tue 2026-03-03). FinTrust hopes to close by end of week. If anything is blocked by legal/NDAs, call it out.

Thanks — Hannah

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG follow-up + outstanding evidence items — action items

Quick status update — I pulled the signed InfoSec policy and the retention schedule and exported them to PDF. Also generated a short manifest (redwood_SIG_drive_manifest.pdf) that maps each SIG question to the artifact. Links below (view-only):

- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3Redwood-FINTRUST-SIG
- InfoSec Policy (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1policy-doc-redwood/view 
- Retention Schedule (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1retention-schedule-redwood/view 
- SIG manifest (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1manifest-redwood/view

Note: The SOC 2 summary we can provide but the full SOC 2 report requires a DPA addendum; I flagged that in the manifest.

Also attaching small stubs (referenced as attachments) for the files so Marissa can quickly scan: redwood_SIG_drive_manifest.pdf (attachment), policy-signature-stub.txt (attachment).

-Dev
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@fintrust.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence: network diagram, runbook screenshot, audit log (links)

Hi Asha / Hannah — attaching the artifacts requested. Links below (view-only). All items are in the folder Dev created.

- Network diagram (PNG, redaction applied): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1network-diagram-v2/view (network_diagram_v2.png)
- Incident response runbook (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1runbook-incident-response/view (runbook_incident_response_v3.pdf)
- Runbook annotated screenshot (PNG): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1runbook-screenshot-annotated/view
- Audit log screenshot (timestamped): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1audit_log_20260303/view (audit_log_20260303.png)

Audit screenshot notes: query used "SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE action = 'token.create' AND timestamp >= '2026-03-01' LIMIT 1"; timestamp shown is 2026-03-03T14:06:22Z. We redacted user identifiers.

If you need the live query or a signed expiring link, let me know and we can produce a signed URL (48-hour).

Thanks,
Vivek
Security & Compliance Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@fintrust.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 07:53:00 -0700
Subject: SIG artifacts — consolidated Drive folder (FinTrust)

Hi Asha — shared below is a consolidated, view-only Drive folder containing the artifacts we discussed. Each filename has a short note in the manifest mapping it to the SIG question number.

Drive folder (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3Redwood-FINTRUST-SIG

Highlights:
- Policy & retention: InfoSec_Policy_signed_2025-11.pdf; Data_Retention_Schedule_2025.pdf
- Network diagram: network_diagram_v2.png (internal IPs redacted; legend included)
- Runbook: runbook_incident_response_v3.pdf + runbook_screenshot_annotated.png
- Audit log screenshot: audit_log_20260303.png (redacted identifiers; query included in filename)

Attachments referenced: redwood_SIG_drive_manifest.pdf (maps to SIG questions), policy-signature-stub.txt.

If FinTrust needs any of these artifacts delivered via a different secure channel or requires a signed expiring URL for the audit screenshot, we can provide that (please confirm preferred expiry). Also, note the full SOC 2 report will require an executed DPA addendum per our policy — we’ve called that out in the manifest.

Please let us know if you want any additional screenshots (e.g., role-based access controls for a specific service) and we’ll pull them.

Regards,
Hannah
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@fintrust.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@fintrust.com
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG artifacts — consolidated Drive folder (FinTrust)

Thanks Hannah — this is excellent and exactly what we need. One small follow-up: could you also provide a timestamped screenshot showing a sample entry for a privileged role change (policy: role.assign) from the audit console? The current audit screenshot covers token.create. If you can share that in the same folder (view-only) we can mark the SIG as closed on our side.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Asha
